messages:
jon-sales: Hey team, AcmeHealth legal sent back the contract with a handful of redlines and an EU data residency addendum. They also want the PO to be applied before signature. Can we confirm next steps?
marie-legal: I skimmed — main asks: (1) tighten data processing terms for EU controllers, (2) add KMS/HSM clause for customer-managed keys, (3) change SLA uptime from 99.9% to 99.95% and add penalty language, and (4) clarify audit right timelines.
alex-ps: Procurement question from Acme: billing needs invoice on receipt of signed order form and they require net30. They also want a PO# pinned to the agreement metadata. Is net30 okay?
jon-sales: Net30 is standard for this enterprise cohort, yes. Finance prefers net30 for renewals too. kate-ops: FYI finance-bot flagged that we need a billing contact, and they want the envelope routed to their AP team after signatures. I can set up DocuSign routing once legal confirms signatory block.
marie-legal: On the KMS clause, we can add a customer-managed keys section but need to confirm supported integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). Sam, can you confirm runtime support and any rollout constraints?
sam-engineer: We support AWS KMS today for Private and Dedicated; GCP KMS is in testing on the private stack (ETA 3 weeks), Azure KV not supported yet. If they require HSM-backed KMS with specific FIPS attestations we need to surface that.
jon-sales: Acme specifically called out HSM + key escrow restrictions. Marie, would an exception for an implementation timeline (e.g., "support within X months") be acceptable instead of an immediate HSM guarantee?
marie-legal: We can offer a roadmap commitment: add a clause "Customer may request HSM-backed keys; Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide support within 90 days of request" — but legal wants a fallback (customer can use Dedicated with BYOK earlier).
alex-ps: I'll propose that in the commercial terms: Dedicated + BYOK available immediately for a surcharge; public/private KMS support roadmap for hosted plan.
jon-sales: Good. Also their security team asked for SOC2 Type II and penetration test report before sign. We have SOC2 attestation link already — do we attach link or include an explicit warranty?
marie-legal: Attach link and include standard warranty that we maintain industry-standard security certifications; don't promise future attestations. For pen test, we can provide a redacted report under NDA — ask Acme to sign the mutual NDA first.
kate-ops: Routing note — customer wants Legal -> Procurement -> AP -> Exec signature. The envelope needs conditional routing: if PO present, route to AP first; else route to sales exec. DocuSign supports conditional routing with a checkbox.
jon-sales: I'll update the order form to surface a "PO attached" checkbox and a PO# field. Who can draft that order form change?
alex-ps: I can patch the order form template. Need the exact language for invoice timing ("invoice upon countersignature vs invoice upon delivery"). They requested invoice on signature. Finance: any objections?
finance-bot: finance-bot: flagged — invoice on signature + net30 accepted for customers with credit checks. If they want invoice on PO receipt (pre-signature), we need GL hold workflows.
jon-sales: Acme wants invoice generated once we receive their PO even if signature pending. That will require ops change — kate-ops can you confirm if we can honor that?
kate-ops: We can process a PO as a payable reference but we can't recognize revenue without a signed contract. We can accept a PO for procurement purposes but billing will still wait for countersignature unless legal confirms otherwise.
marie-legal: I'm not comfortable recognizing invoice terms that bypass signature. We'll agree to procurement workflows (PO on file) but invoices will be issued upon countersignature. I'll add a clause: "Customer may provide a purchase order for procurement purposes; invoice issuance remains contingent on executed agreement."
sam-engineer: One more technical blocker: Acme's POC requires Private deployment inside EU region with VPC-only access. That affects onboarding timeline (we need infra lead). Jon, is that part of the commercial POC scope?
jon-sales: Yes, POC scope includes EU private tenancy for 30 days. Need SOW addendum. Alex, please add a scoped SOW line item: "30-day Private POC in EU, includes onboarding support (2 engineers, 10 hours), billing waived as POC credit".
alex-ps: Will do. Marie, any concerns about POC IP or data use language?
marie-legal: Add a narrow clause: "Data used solely for POC; Redwood will not use POC data for model training or benchmarking absent separate consent." That should close the data usage ask.
jon-sales: Timeline check — can legal deliver redline back by EOD tomorrow so we can route?
marie-legal: I'll send a tracked-redline by 6pm PT. If they insist on immediate HSM proof, escalate to product for temporary BYOK options.
jon-sales: Thanks. I'll notify Acme procurement that we're working the redlines and will send a DocuSign envelope with conditional routing once final. :thumbsup:
